boundary_reason: Stable policy selection of 80 revisions, no source-identity truncation. Source verification is not semantic completion.

entries.source: #Target#'s is vulnerable to attacks and effects!
A note explaining the arena's scoring rules. Someone must have dropped it.
entries.target: 一张介绍竞技场积分规则的笔记。是有人丢下了这张纸。

entries.source: The target is able to instantly travel alongside Sun Paths.
entries.target: 目标可以在阳光大道上瞬间行走。

entries.source: Write a description for this gem's properties!

Unleash a flurry of disruptive kicks at your target's vulnerable areas. For each combo point you attack for %d%% weapon damage and deactivate one physical sustain.
			At talent level 3 #DARK_ORCHID#Magical#LAST# sustains will also be effected.
			At talent level 5 #YELLOW#Mental#LAST# sustains will also be effected.
			Using this talent removes your combo points.
entries.target:
每有一个连击点，对目标造成 %d%% 武器伤害，并解除目标一项物理持续技能。
		等级 3 时，#DARK_ORCHID#魔法#LAST#持续技能也会受影响。
		等级 5 时，#YELLOW#精神#LAST#持续技能也会受影响。
		使用该技能将除去全部连击点。

entries.source: take root increasing health by 300, armor by 20, and armor hardiness by 20%% but rooting you in place for 4 turns
entries.target: 扎根，增加300点生命、20点护甲和20%%护甲强度，但不能移动，持续4回合。

entries.source: Maybe it is time for you to start an adventurer's career. Deep below the Iron Throne mountains lies the Deep Bellow.
entries.target: 也许是你开始冒险生涯的时候了，在钢铁王座山脉的深处有个叫深渊咆哮的地下城。

entries.source: turn into a corrupted losgoroth (poison, disease, cut and confusion immune; converts half damage into life drain; does not require breath) for 10 turns
entries.target: 转变为一只堕落的洛斯格罗斯（毒素、疾病、撕裂和混乱免疫）十回合，转换一半伤害为生命吸收，不需要呼吸。

entries.source: It was my pleasure. But may I ask a favor myself? I am not from these lands. I used a farportal guarded by orcs deep below the Iron Throne and was brought here.
entries.target: 我的荣幸，不过我有个请求。我其实不是这个大陆的人，使用了钢铁王座地下深处，被兽人保护的远行传送门，然后就到了这里。

entries.source: The fabric of time around #target# stabilizes to normal.
Warriors from afar. They wield the power of light, and a mean sword. Darkness, too.
entries.target: 来自远方的战士。他们擅长光魔法和华丽的剑技，同样也精通暗魔法。

entries.source: Each time that you make a melee attack you have a 50%% chance to execute an additional unarmed strike.
entries.target: 每当你进行近战攻击时，有 50%% 几率追加一次额外的徒手攻击。

entries.source: #LIGHT_GREEN#You may have to revist your past to unlock some secret buried there.
entries.target: #LIGHT_GREEN#你可以回忆一下过去来解开埋藏在这里的秘密。

entries.source: Fire a poisoned dart dealing %0.2f physical damage that puts the target to sleep for 4 turns. 10 turn cooldown.
entries.target: 发射毒镖，造成 %0.2f 物理伤害，沉睡 4 回合。10 回合冷却时间。

entries.source: Great work! And you're still in one piece, I see. Always nice. I feel the same way after safely brewing up a particularly tricky mixture. I've near blown my face clean off several times. Oh, while you were gone a little bird told me that %s has managed to create a %s. Don't let him finish before me!
entries.target: 干得好！而且你完好无损地回来了。很好，这和我费尽心思做好一瓶特效药剂的感觉一样好。我有好几次都差点把自己的脸炸飞了。哦对了，你不在的时候有一只小鸟告诉我说 %s 已经制造了 %s。别让他超过我！

entries.source: Absorbs %d damage from the next blockable attack.  Currently Blocking: %s.
entries.target: 吸收下一次可格挡攻击造成的 %d 点伤害。当前格挡：%s。

entries.source: You may select a chronomancy spell to Quicken, reducing the time it takes you to cast that spell.
entries.target: 你可以选择一个时空系法术来施展“迅捷施法”，加快这个技能的释放速度。
#LIGHT_BLUE# * +0 魔法，+6 意志，+4 灵巧

entries.source:
Curses your target, decreasing all its resistances by %d%% for 7 turns.
		The effect will improve with your Spellpower.
entries.target:
诅咒目标，减少其 %d%% 所有抵抗，持续 7 回合。
		效果受法术强度加成。

entries.source:
#GOLD#Activated Talents#LAST#
Most talents require activation (i.e. time) to use, and create a specific effect when called upon.
Specific information on each talent appears its tooltip.
entries.target:
#GOLD#主动技能#LAST#
大部分技能都需要主动（花费时间）来使用，并且会在使用的时候触发额外的效果。
有关技能的详细信息，请参阅技能的提示框。

entries.source: As you approach it, you hear a high-pitched buzzing sound.
entries.target: 当你靠近它时，你听到一阵刺耳的嗡嗡声。

entries.source: Go away; I do not care for the weak.
entries.target: 走开；我可不在乎弱者的死活。

entries.source:
Talent category points allow you to either:
- learn a new talent (class or generic) category
- improve a known talent category efficiency by 0.2
- learn a new inscription slot (up to a maximum of 5, learning it is automatic when using an inscription)

You gain a new point at level 10, 20 and 34.
Some races or items may increase them as well.
entries.target:
技能树解锁点有以下作用：
- 解锁职业或通用技能树
- 提升一个技能树所有技能等级，每点提升 0.2
- 解锁新的刻印位（最多 5 个，你使用刻印时会自动消耗点数解锁）
你会在人物等级达到 10、20 和 34 级时各获得 1 个点数。
某些种族和物品可以获得额外的点数。

entries.source: This set of robes seems to shine with metallic colors.
entries.target: 这套长袍闪烁着金属般的光辉。

entries.source: Moving at extreme speed (%d%% faster) and gains 100%% stun, daze and pinning immunity. Any action other than movement will cancel it.
entries.target: 以极快的速度移动 (加速 %d%%) 并获得 100%% 震慑、眩晕和定身免疫。任何非移动动作都会取消这一效果。

entries.source: You cannot use Last Stand without a shield!
entries.target: 必须装备一面盾牌施展该技能！

entries.source:
You chant the glory of the Sun, granting you %d%% fire, lightning, acid and cold damage resistance, %d spell save and reduces the damage from enemies 3 or more spaces away by %d%%.
	You may only have one Chant active at once.
	The effects will increase with your Spellpower.
entries.target:
颂赞日之荣耀，使你获得 %d%% 火焰、闪电、酸性和寒冷抗性，%d 法术豁免，并减少三格外敌人对你造成的伤害 %d%%。
	同时只能激活一种赞歌。
	效果受法术强度加成。

entries.source: You kept the Orb of Many Ways despite Tannen's request to study it. You must now look for the athame and diamond in Reknor.
entries.target: 尽管泰恩想要研究多元水晶球，你还是把它留在了自己手中。现在你必须去瑞库纳寻找仪式匕首和共鸣钻石。

entries.source: This girdle is enchanted with mighty wards against expanding girth. Whatever the source of its wondrous strength, it will prove of great aid in the transport of awkward burdens.
entries.target: 这条腰带被赋予了神秘的魔力来对抗膨胀的腰围。不管它蕴含着的是何种力量，它总是能在你负重不足时助你一臂之力。

entries.source: The target is concealed, increasing sight and attack range by %d and chance to avoid damage by %d%%.
entries.target: 目标处于隐匿状态，增加攻击范围和视野 %d格，有%d%% 几率躲闪攻击。

entries.source:
Conjures up mana into a powerful bolt doing %0.2f arcane damage.
		At level 3, it becomes a beam.
		The damage will increase with your Spellpower.
entries.target:
将法力凝聚成一枚强力的法力弹，造成 %0.2f 点奥术伤害。
		技能等级达到 3 时，法力弹会变为光束。
		伤害随法术强度提高。

entries.source: A small water demon, lobbing spells at you.
entries.target: 水中的小恶魔，向你投出法术。

entries.source: This heavy, ridged blade emanates magical power, yet as you grasp the handle an icy chill runs its course through your spine. You feel the disembodied presence of all those slain by it. In unison, they demand company.
entries.target: 这把沉重的，有着锯齿状刀刃的长剑正在向外散发强大的魔法波动，当你握住剑时，一阵寒意从剑柄传来，直刺灵魂。你仿佛感觉到了葬身剑下的亡灵，他们渴望着更多同伴的到来。
